roles.heading: Roles & Permissions
roles.headingSub: Roles are for internal administrator accounts. Select permissions for each role; Super Admin always has full access.
roles.deleteBody: The custom role will be deleted from the system. This action is recorded in the activity log.
roles.confirmBody: Changes ({n}) will apply immediately to all accounts with these roles and will be recorded in the activity log.

admins.heading: Administrator accounts
admins.count: Internal accounts with Admin Dashboard access: {n} · separate from member accounts
admins.confirmBody: {name} ({email}) will immediately lose access to the Admin Dashboard. This action is recorded in the activity log.
admins.lockBody: {name} will be signed out and cannot sign in until the account is unlocked.

drawer.title: Create administrator account
drawer.sub: Administrator accounts sign in to the Admin Dashboard. They do not appear in the Members menu and cannot sign in to the User Portal. Use a separate internal email.
drawer.name: Full name
drawer.roleHint: Edit detailed permissions for each role on the Roles & Permissions tab.
drawer.passwordHint: Send it together with the sign-in email; the password must be changed on first sign-in.

sso.heading: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.headingSub: Enabled providers appear on the sign-in and registration forms.
sso.configToast: Open Client ID / Secret settings for {name}
sso.tfaDesc: Require a verification code when signing in to the Admin Dashboard
sso.lockout: Temporarily lock after 5 failed sign-in attempts
